correctness.rationale: All m>=4 and all three-block partitions. The simplex row-space representation yields the exact projection quadratic form. An orthogonal decomposition gives within-block contrast eigenvalues and the trace-one two-dimensional block-mean determinant. For two singleton blocks, two independent Rayleigh certificates give \(t=m/(3m-2)\), attained with unique probabilities. For one singleton, strict determinant monotonicity proves \(t=(m+1)/(3m+1)\) and uniqueness. With no singleton, contrast eigenvalues force <=1/3, attained uniformly. The inequalities are strict between size-profile classes. Standalone check.py executed successfully: 218 exact symbolic/rational assertions; finite checks only supplement the proof.

value.rationale: Sharp natural fixed-three-block minimax design over both a discrete partition and continuous sampling probabilities, all dimensions m>=4, all equality cases and constrained-profile optima. The structural optimizer is maximally unbalanced despite traditional paving motivation for balanced blocks. It is a quantitative benchmark for exact simultaneous row projections; small improvement and computational-cost caveats are explicit.
